answer: To fortify Sybil resistance, we employ recursive zero-knowledge reputation commitments and verifiable delay primitives to ensure information-theoretic unforgeability, rendering identity cloning computationally infeasible. Specifically, reputation commitments plume a trail of progressively convincing proofs, linking parties across interactions, while verifiable delay functions introduce a delta of time between commitment and reveal, deterring adversaries seeking to sable their existence by presenting a false identity.
